definitions.explanation: A flat paper container for a letter.

examples.japanese: {手紙|てがみ}を{封筒|ふうとう}に{入|い}れる。
examples.english: To put a letter in an envelope.

examples.japanese: {封筒|ふうとう}に{切手|きって}を{貼|は}る。
examples.english: To put a stamp on an envelope.

examples.japanese: {白|しろ}い{封筒|ふうとう}をください。
examples.english: Please give me a white envelope.

notes:
{封筒|ふうとう} is an envelope, from {封|ふう} (seal) + {筒|とう} (tube/cylinder).

TYPES OF ENVELOPES:
- {長形|ながけい}{封筒|ふうとう}: long envelope
- {角形|かくけい}{封筒|ふうとう}: square envelope
- {茶封筒|ちゃぶうとう}: brown envelope
- {窓付|まどつき}き{封筒|ふうとう}: window envelope

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {封筒|ふうとう}に{入|い}れる: to put in an envelope
- {封筒|ふうとう}を{開|あ}ける: to open an envelope
- {封筒|ふうとう}に{切手|きって}を{貼|は}る: to put a stamp on an envelope
- {封|ふう}をする: to seal (an envelope)

RELATED POSTAL ITEMS:
- {手紙|てがみ}: letter
- {切手|きって}: postage stamp
- {宛名|あてな}: address/addressee
- {差出人|さしだしにん}: sender
